name: wallx-play
description: WallX Play — multi-tenant digital signage SaaS

scripts.build: npm run build -w @wallx-play/web && npm run build -w @wallx-play/functions
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,storage --project demo-wallx-play "vitest run --config tests/vitest.emulator.config.ts"
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w @wallx-play/functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-wallx-play
